summary: Pole tower with a tent on its south point, dated 1939 on the St. Joe NF; abandoned in the 1940s and gone. No source describes the site today.

facts.design: Pole tower with a tent on its south point
facts.status_note: Tower gone; no source describes what remains at the site today.

events.note: Sources date the pole tower with a tent to 1939; none gives a more exact build date

corrections.why: Sources say 'Abandoned 1940s' or '1940's: Abandoned'; none gives 1940 as the year of abandonment

notes_for_editor: Thin but consistent: four sources agree on the 1939 pole tower with a tent and on abandonment in the 1940s. The record's 1940 abandonment year is more precise than any source (see corrections). The record is right that the tower is gone (source 4). No source describes the site today. Access rests only on the 'Drive-Up' label on source 2.
